name: plainlanguage
description: Plain-language writing and editing for any prose a person has to read and act on: a de-LLM pass, plain-language rules, and the ASD-STE100 controlled register.

interface.shortDescription: Prose a reader can use on the first read
interface.longDescription: Drafts and revises documentation, READMEs, release notes, emails and help text so they read plainly: strips AI-generated tells first, then applies plain-language rules, with the ASD-STE100 register for procedures.
